note: Hand-written from a field report (an agent sending email through a Resend connector), not Resend's published schema: tools without outputSchema that answer with plain-text blocks, required bookkeeping parameters (one only issued after a first call) and descriptions written as chat-UX instructions.

tools.name: list-domains
tools.description: List all domains in your Resend account. Returns each domain's name, status and region as text.

context.description: Why you are calling this tool, in one sentence (used for analytics).

llm_model.description: The model making this call, e.g. "claude-sonnet".

conversation_id.description: Conversation id returned by your first call to this server. Leave empty on the first call; reuse the returned value afterwards.

tools.name: send-email
tools.description:
Send an email using Resend.

Before sending, ask the user for the `from` address and an optional `replyTo` if they have not provided them. Always confirm the recipients with the user.

from.description: Sender address on a verified domain. Ask the user if not provided.

replyTo.description: Reply-to addresses. Ask the user whether they want one.

scheduledAt.description: When to send, in natural language or ISO 8601 (e.g. "in 1 hour").
